# Radio props

## Radio.Item Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | — | Classes for the item's `<label>`. A string only: the label has no Base UI state to pass to a function. Style the radio itself with `Radio.Root`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | required | Label text displayed next to the radio indicator. |
